current.text: He signed with Minnesota and is the projected fifth starter. Reports say he was promised a starting spot.
Experts doubt the starting role will hold. He may start in name only, play about 21 minutes and lose closing minutes to another player. His starting spot is not guaranteed for the whole season.
He is shooting 23% from the field in preseason.
His usage should drop next to Anthony Edwards, LaMelo Ball and Jaden McDaniels, but it should stay above 20%.

He is a late flyer only. Do not take him inside the top 100. A Yahoo rank around 115 is fine. Drop him quickly if his role does not grow. Experts rejected the earlier mid-round prices (Yahoo rank 50, ESPN rank 44, a fourth-round pick).

With a March 28 end, Minnesota plays 4, 2 and 4 games in the fantasy playoff weeks. The two-game week is the semifinal, which is the week starting March 15. The team has 13 back-to-backs, the league minimum.
Minnesota is expected to compete and win about 53 games, so it should not rest players to tank.

durable.text: He is a scorer who adds little else. His steals, blocks and assists are poor.
Free throws are a clear weakness. He projects at about 69% on 3 to 4 attempts a game, which is a league outlier on the weak side. Experts also call his three-point shooting poor.
He is worth more in points leagues than in 9-cat category leagues.
His big fantasy games come when teammates are out. When they return, his role shrinks. Overall his fantasy production has been disappointing.
Experts see him as a negative on defense and call him lazy on that end.

note: He sits right at the edge of our 144-player pool (Yahoo rank 136, ESPN rank 186, about 1 USD on both sites and 1 USD in our league last year), so he is a 1 USD last-round flyer at most. His weak FT% (about 69% on 3 to 4 attempts) and thin defensive stats make him a poor fit for most builds; he fits best on a team that already ignores FT%. In the first weeks, check whether he actually plays starter minutes (around 28 rather than 21) and closes games, and whether his 23% preseason shooting recovers. If not, cut him early, and note that Minnesota has only 2 games in our semifinal week.
